newsitem.title: USA: Avic sets Beijing area cable TV upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Avic sets Beijing area cable TV upgrade.

text.p: Avic Group International Inc said Monday it has tentatively agreed to participate in the upgrading and expansion of an existing cable television network in China's Hebei Province.

Avic said its Chinese subsidiary, Hebei Telecommunications Engineering Co, signed the letter of intent after negotiations with the Broadcast Television Commission of Hebei Province and the Electronic Industry Commission of Hebei.
The company said the TV commission, which will operate the network, projects the total project cost at about $45 million and expects that construction will take two years.
An Avic spokesman said the company's stake in the venture, and those of the TV and electronic industry commissions, were not disclosed.

The company said it will be responsible for all financing and construction of the project, which will upgrade the existing coaxial cable TV network to a hybrid fiber-coaxial network capable of two-way high-speed data transmission.

It said the upgraded and expanded network will be capable of providing services beyond cable television, including Internet access, video conferencing, pay-per-view services, private network telephony and fax and data transmission.
Avic also said the TV commission projects the 630,000 current subscribers will grow to some three million over the next three years.
The multimedia project is Avic's second in Hebei, it said.

The first is a cellular telephone network currently under construction and expected to begin initial operations this month. Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp is a partner in the cellular network and is also involved in discussions to participate in the Hebei multimedia network.
The next step in the development of this project is to sign a contract between all parties involved, which is expected within the next four to six weeks, Avic said.
Hebei Province, one of the fastest growing provinces in China, has a population of some 64 million and encircles the cities of Beijing and Tianjin.
